entry.title: Cardiff Castle

terrainReference.basis: NativeY0 follows retained standard viewer DEM12.8751m at anchor. Motte10.8m and palace2.8m floors are approximate exterior estimates. Curtain foundations follow coarse ground.

entry.note: Mapped keep/courtyard, selected castle polygons and entry paths establish approximate scale and signed facing. Untagged architectural levels and terrain/moat joins remain estimates. A replacement corridor covers the two authored named bridge approaches; actual tagged-road suppression must pass before final QA. Native frame follows the mean bridge axis; inverse viewer heading restores the original cardinal fit. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
